verses.en: Behold, and hearken unto the voice of him who has all power, who is from everlasting to everlasting, even Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end.
verses.sm: Faauta, ma faalogo mai i le leo o ia o lē ua i ai le mana uma, o lē ua mai le faavavau-tumau i le faavavau-tumau, o le Alefa ma le Omeka lava, o le amataga ma le gataaga.

verses.en: Behold, verily thus saith the Lord unto you, O ye elders of my church, who are assembled upon this spot, whose sins are now forgiven you, for I, the Lord, forgive sins, and am merciful unto those who confess their sins with humble hearts;
verses.sm: Faauta, e moni ua faapea ona fetalai mai o le Alii ia te outou, o toeaina e o la’u ekalesia, o e ua potopoto i luga o lenei laufanua, o e o a latou agasala ua faamagaloina nei, ona o A’u, o le Alii, e faamagaloina agasala, ma ua Ou alofa mutimutivale ia te i latou o e e ta’uta’u mai a latou agasala ma loto maualalalo;

verses.en: But verily I say unto you, that it is not needful for this whole company of mine elders to be moving swiftly upon the waters, whilst the inhabitants on either side are perishing in unbelief.
verses.sm: Peitai e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, ua lē manaomia ona o atu faavavevave le vaega atoa lenei o a’u toeaina i luga o vai, ae o loo fano i le lē talitonu tagata o loo nonofo ai i le tasi itu ma le isi itu.

verses.en: Nevertheless, I suffered it that ye might bear record; behold, there are many dangers upon the waters, and more especially hereafter;
verses.sm: Ae ui i lea, na Ou tuuina atu ina ia mafai ona outou molimauina; faauta, e tele mea e lamatia ai le ola o loo i ai i luga o vai, ma aemaise lava pe a mavae le taimi nei;

verses.en: For I, the Lord, have decreed in mine anger many destructions upon the waters; yea, and especially upon these waters.
verses.sm: Aua o A’u, o le Alii, ua Ou poloaiina i lo’u ita faafanoga e tele i luga o vai; ioe, ma aemaise lava i luga o nei vai.

verses.en: Nevertheless, all flesh is in mine hand, and he that is faithful among you shall not perish by the waters.
verses.sm: Ae ui i lea, ua i ai tagata uma i lo’u lima, ma o lē o i totonu o outou ua faamaoni o le a lē fano i vai.

verses.en: Wherefore, it is expedient that my servant Sidney Gilbert and my servant William W. Phelps be in haste upon their errand and mission.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, ua tatau ai lava i la’u auauna o Sini Gilbert ma la’u auauna o Viliamu W. Phelps ona faanatinati atu i la laua fe’au ma le misiona.

verses.en: Nevertheless, I would not suffer that ye should part until you were chastened for all your sins, that you might be one, that you might not perish in wickedness;
verses.sm: Ae ui i lea, Ou te lē tuuina atu ia outou taapeape seia aoaiina outou ona o a outou agasala uma, ina ia tasi outou, ina ia outou lē fano i le amioleaga;

verses.en: But now, verily I say, it behooveth me that ye should part. Wherefore let my servants Sidney Gilbert and William W. Phelps take their former company, and let them take their journey in haste that they may fill their mission, and through faith they shall overcome;
verses.sm: Ae o nei, e moni Ou te fai atu, ua Ou loto ina ia outou o atu. O lea ia tuu atu i a’u auauna o Sini Gilbert ma Viliamu W. Phelps e ave la laua aumalaga muamua, ma tuu atu ia te i latou e alu faanatinati la latou malaga ina ia mafai ona latou faataunuu la latou misiona, ma o le a latou manumalo e ala i le faatuatua;

verses.en: And inasmuch as they are faithful they shall be preserved, and I, the Lord, will be with them.
verses.sm: Ma e tusa ai ma lo latou faamaoni o le a faasaoina i latou, ma o A’u, o le Alii, o le a faatasi ma i latou.

verses.en: And let the residue take that which is needful for clothing.
verses.sm: Ma ia tuu atu i toeaina e totoe latou te ave mea e manaomia mo lavalava.

verses.en: Let my servant Sidney Gilbert take that which is not needful with him, as you shall agree.
verses.sm: Ia tuu atu i la’u auauna o Sini Gilbert na te ave faatasi ma ia mea e lē manaomia, e pei ona o le a outou malilie i ai.

verses.en: And now, behold, for your good I gave unto you a commandment concerning these things; and I, the Lord, will reason with you as with men in days of old.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, faauta, e mo lo outou lelei na Ou tuu atu ai ia te outou se poloaiga e faatatau i nei mea; ma o A’u, o le Alii, o le a talatala faatasi ma outou e pei ona sa faia ma tagata i aso anamua.

verses.en: Behold, I, the Lord, in the beginning blessed the waters; but in the last days, by the mouth of my servant John, I cursed the waters.
verses.sm: Faauta, o A’u, o le Alii, na faamanuiaina vai i le amataga; ae i aso e gata ai, ua Ou fetuu ai vai, e ala i le fofoga o la’u auauna o Ioane.

verses.en: Wherefore, the days will come that no flesh shall be safe upon the waters.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, e oo mai aso o le a lē saogalemu ai se tasi i luga o vai.

verses.en: And it shall be said in days to come that none is able to go up to the land of Zion upon the waters, but he that is upright in heart.
verses.sm: Ma o le a fai ane faapea i aso e oo mai, e leai se tasi e mafai ona alu a’e i le laueleele o Siona i luga o vai, na’o ia o lē ua sa’o i le loto.

verses.en: And, as I, the Lord, in the beginning cursed the land, even so in the last days have I blessed it, in its time, for the use of my saints, that they may partake the fatness thereof.
verses.sm: Ma, e pei ona fetuu, e A’u, o le Alii, le laueleele i le amataga, ua faapea foi ona Ou faamanuiaina i aso e gata ai, i lona taimi, mo le faaaogaina e la’u au paia, ina ia latou aai i lona tamaoaiga.

verses.en: And now I give unto you a commandment that what I say unto one I say unto all, that you shall forewarn your brethren concerning these waters, that they come not in journeying upon them, lest their faith fail and they are caught in snares;
verses.sm: Ma o lenei Ou te tuu atu ia te outou se poloaiga, o mea Ou te fai atu ai i le toatasi Ou te fai atu ai i tagata uma, ia outou muai lapataia o outou uso e faatatau i vai nei, ina ia latou lē malaga mai ai i luga o nei vai, ne’i leai so o latou faatuatua ma maua ai i latou i mailei;

verses.en: I, the Lord, have decreed, and the destroyer rideth upon the face thereof, and I revoke not the decree.
verses.sm: O A’u, o le Alii, ua Ou poloaiina, ma ua tietie lē faaumatiaina i luga o vai, ma Ou te lē aveesea le poloaiga.

verses.en: I, the Lord, was angry with you yesterday, but today mine anger is turned away.
verses.sm: O A’u, o le Alii, sa Ou ita ia te outou ananafi, ae o le asō ua liliuese lo’u ita.

verses.en: Wherefore, let those concerning whom I have spoken, that should take their journey in haste—again I say unto you, let them take their journey in haste.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, ia tuu atu ia te i latou o e na Ou tautala atu ai, e tatau ona faanatinati la latou malaga— Ou te toe fai atu ia te outou, ia tuu atu ia te i latou ia faanatinati la latou malaga.

verses.en: And it mattereth not unto me, after a little, if it so be that they fill their mission, whether they go by water or by land; let this be as it is made known unto them according to their judgments hereafter.
verses.sm: Ma e lē afaina ia te a’u, pe a mavae se taimi itiiti, pe afai latou te faataunuu la latou misiona, pe latou te malaga atu i le vai po o le laueleele; ia tuu lenei mea ia faia e pei ona faailoa atu ia te i latou e tusa ma a latou filifiliga pe a mavae le taimi nei.

verses.en: And now, concerning my servants, Sidney Rigdon, Joseph Smith, Jun., and Oliver Cowdery, let them come not again upon the waters, save it be upon the canal, while journeying unto their homes; or in other words they shall not come upon the waters to journey, save upon the canal.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, e faatatau i a’u auauna, o Sini Rikitone, Iosefa Samita, Le Itiiti, ma Oliva Kaotui, ia tuu atu ia te i latou ia aua ne’i toe o mai i luga o vai, vagana i luga o le alavaa vaiti, a’o malaga atu i o latou aiga; po o faapea, aua ne’i o latou o mai i luga o vai e malaga atu ai, vagana ai i luga o le alavaa vaiti.

verses.en: Behold, I, the Lord, have appointed a way for the journeying of my saints; and behold, this is the way—that after they leave the canal they shall journey by land, inasmuch as they are commanded to journey and go up unto the land of Zion;
verses.sm: Faauta, o A’u, o le Alii, ua ’Ou tofia se ala mo le malaga a la’u au paia; ma faauta, o le ala lenei— a mavae ona latou tuua le alavaa vaiti, ia latou malaga e ala atu i le laueleele, talu ai ona ua poloaiina i latou e malaga atu ma o atu i luga i le laueleele o Siona;

verses.en: And they shall do like unto the children of Israel, pitching their tents by the way.
verses.sm: Ma ia latou faia e pei ona sa faia e le fanauga a Isaraelu, e faatutu o latou faleie i tafatafa o le ala.

verses.en: And, behold, this commandment you shall give unto all your brethren.
verses.sm: Ma, faauta, o lenei poloaiga ia outou tuu atu i o outou uso uma.

verses.en: Nevertheless, unto whom is given power to command the waters, unto him it is given by the Spirit to know all his ways;
verses.sm: Ae ui i lea, o lē ua tuuina atu i ai le mana e poloaiina ai vai, ua tuuina atu ia te ia e le Agaga ia iloa e ia ona ala uma;

verses.en: Wherefore, let him do as the Spirit of the living God commandeth him, whether upon the land or upon the waters, as it remaineth with me to do hereafter.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, ia tuu atu ia te ia e fai e pei ona poloaiina ai o ia e le Agaga o le Atua soifua, pe i luga o le laueleele po o luga o vai, e pei ona tumau ai pea ia te a’u e fai pe a mavae atu nei.

verses.en: And unto you is given the course for the saints, or the way for the saints of the camp of the Lord, to journey.
verses.sm: Ma ua tuu atu ia te outou le ala mo le au paia, po o le ala mo le au paia o le tolauapiga a le Alii, e malaga ai.

verses.en: And again, verily I say unto you, my servants, Sidney Rigdon, Joseph Smith, Jun., and Oliver Cowdery, shall not open their mouths in the congregations of the wicked until they arrive at Cincinnati;
verses.sm: O lenei foi, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, a’u auauna o Sini Rikitone, Iosefa Samita, Le Itiiti, ma Oliva Kaotui, ia aua le tatalaina o latou fofoga i faapotopotoga a e amioleaga seia latou taunuu i Sinisinati;

verses.en: And in that place they shall lift up their voices unto God against that people, yea, unto him whose anger is kindled against their wickedness, a people who are well-nigh ripened for destruction.
verses.sm: Ma i le nofoaga lena, ia siitia a’e i luga o latou leo i le Atua e faasaga i lena nuu, ioe, ia te Ia o lē o lona toasa ua sasao faasaga i lo latou amioleaga, o ni tagata o e ua lata ona matua mo le faafanoga.

verses.en: And from thence let them journey for the congregations of their brethren, for their labors even now are wanted more abundantly among them than among the congregations of the wicked.
verses.sm: Ma mai iina, ia tuu atu ia te i latou e malaga atu i faapotopotoga a o latou uso, ona ua manaomia tele i le taimi nei lava a latou galuega i totonu o i latou, nai lo totonu o faapotopotoga a e amioleaga.

verses.en: And now, concerning the residue, let them journey and declare the word among the congregations of the wicked, inasmuch as it is given;
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, e faatatau i toeaina o totoe, ia tuu atu ia te i latou e malaga atu ma talai atu le afioga i totonu o faapotopotoga a e amioleaga, e pei ona tuuina mai ai;

verses.en: And inasmuch as they do this they shall rid their garments, and they shall be spotless before me.
verses.sm: Ma e tusa ai ma lo latou faia o lenei mea o le a latou tafi ai o latou ofu, ma o le a latou lē pōnā ai i o’u luma.

verses.en: And let them journey together, or two by two, as seemeth them good, only let my servant Reynolds Cahoon, and my servant Samuel H. Smith, with whom I am well pleased, be not separated until they return to their homes, and this for a wise purpose in me.
verses.sm: Ma ia tuu atu ia te i latou e malaga faatasi, pe taitoalua, e pei ona lelei ia te i latou, tau ina tuu atu i la’u auauna o Reynolds Cahoon, ma la’u auauna o Samuel H. Samita, o e ua Ou fiafia tele i ai, ia aua ne’i o eseese seia toe foi atu i o laua aiga, ma o lenei mea ua mo se faamoemoega poto ua ia te a’u.

verses.en: And now, verily I say unto you, and what I say unto one I say unto all, be of good cheer, little children; for I am in your midst, and I have not forsaken you;
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, ma o le mea Ou te fai atu ai i le toatasi ua Ou fai atu ai i tagata uma, ia fiafia, le fanau iti e; ona ua Ou i ai i lo outou lotolotoi, ma Ou te lei tuulafoaia outou;

verses.en: And inasmuch as you have humbled yourselves before me, the blessings of the kingdom are yours.
verses.sm: Ma e tusa ai ma lo outou faamaualaloina o outou lava i o’u luma, o faamanuiaga o le malo o a outou ia.

verses.en: Gird up your loins and be watchful and be sober, looking forth for the coming of the Son of Man, for he cometh in an hour you think not.
verses.sm: Fusi i o outou sulugatiti ma mataala ma faamamalu, ma tulimatai i luma mo le afio mai o le Atalii o le Tagata, ona e afio mai o ia i le itula tou te lē manatu i ai.

verses.en: Pray always that you enter not into temptation, that you may abide the day of his coming, whether in life or in death. Even so. Amen.
verses.sm: Tatalo e lē aunoa ina ia outou lē ulu atu i faaosoosoga, ina ia mafai ona outou gafatia le aso o lona afio mai, pe i le ola po o le oti. E faapea lava. Amene.
